Andy Burnham Defends Comments on UK's Bond Market Exposure

Andy Burnham has reiterated his belief that the UK is excessively exposed to global shocks, defending remarks he made previously where he stated the UK should be less "in hock" to bond markets. He claims his comments were deliberately misinterpreted by Keir Starmer and his advisors.
